subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**with**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the life cycle of Banana.
 
• Now, the word in blank 4 will imply how the fruit reacts when it comes in the company of ethylene. 
 
• **"With" **is the most appropriate preposition to use in this context.
 
 
• **"With"** is used to defined something in the company of somebody/something; in or to the same place as somebody/something.
 
 
• **Example**: *The header row is connected **with**__ the data row through the use of commas in CSV format.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.
 
• Correct passage:

The life __cycle__ of a banana is a colourful one; it starts with a deep green, changes to a delicious yellow and ends at an unappetizing brown. Bananas, like most fruits, produce and __react__ with an airborne hormone called ethylene. This hormone helps to signal the ripening process. An unripe fruit is hard and acidic. It is likely to possess a greenish __hue__ due to the presence of chlorophyll. When a fruit comes into contact __**with**__ ethylene, the acids in the fruit start to break down, it becomes softer and the green chlorophyll is ______ (5) ______ and replaced, in the case of bananas, with a yellow hue. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Over"** would not be appropriate as it suggests a sense of physical location or movement.
 
• **"From"** would not be appropriate as it suggests a sense of direction or origin.
 
• **"By"** would not be appropriate as it suggests a sense of agency or method.
